name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Among the ruined pillars of Bashal'Aran, Asterion seeks release from his prison. He has traced the binding magic to the satyrs who command the grells. Now he asks travelers to recover the Ancient Moonstone Seal.

sections.title: A Prison of Ancient Stone
sections.body:
For more than a thousand years, Asterion has been bound within the ruins of Bashal'Aran. The marble pillars mark the bounds of his prison. His strength and ancient magic cannot carry him beyond them. A cursed relic holds him there.

Through the centuries, Asterion has watched Darkshore's canopy. He wonders if the worn stone around him might ever set him free.

sections.title: Satyrs and the Moonstone Seal
sections.body: Nearby grells bore traces of the magic binding Asterion. From them, he reasoned that the Ancient Moonstone Seal was the enchantment's source. The satyrs who command the grells hold the seal now. These demonic night elves roam the ancient groves and keep watch over the relic. Asterion needs travelers to recover the seal so its binding power can be broken.

faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient night elf spirit trapped among Bashal'Aran's ruined pillars. Ancient magic has bound him for more than a thousand years, keeping him from leaving his stone prison or passing on.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs have the Ancient Moonstone Seal?
faq.answer: The satyrs command the wild grells of northern Darkshore. Asterion sensed traces of his binding magic in the grells, then deduced that the satyrs held the Ancient Moonstone Seal, the source of his captivity.

faq.q: What happens once the seal is recovered?
faq.answer: When Asterion takes the recovered Ancient Moonstone Seal, the relic that bound him for centuries, it can be broken. Then he will be free to walk the forests again.

Bashal'Aran is an ancient night elf ruin on the misty shores of northern Darkshore. Once a magnificent settlement or holy enclave, it now lies broken, plagued by grells, satyrs, and trapped spirits from an earlier age.

faq.q: How long has Asterion been trapped here?
faq.answer: Asterion has been imprisoned for more than a thousand years. Neither strength nor magic can break the boundary, and through the centuries he has wondered if he will ever be free.

faq.q: Can Asterion simply walk away from the shrine?
faq.answer: No. The Ancient Moonstone Seal maintains a barrier around the shrine, and the stone pillars keep Asterion's spirit from crossing beyond them.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, Bashal'Aran recalls your people's ancient past. Lingering ancestors remain chained to the earth by satyrs, whose kind embody the demonic betrayal of the Sundering.
As a Druid, you know the satyrs' influence still corrupts Darkshore's wildlife. It also disturbs ancient spirits who should rest peacefully in nature's cycle.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Kalimdor's northern coast by cleansing Darkshore's ruins of satyr corruption. That work also helps the Kaldorei lay their tragic past to rest.
